reviews.title: Great card, price is meh for what is it, but for Amazon prices it's amazing.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1OaUuYQUHL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/715H6ZiEy9L._SY256.jpg Pristinely clean and my card looked almost new, and the price is alright. Ranges for this card on the used market go from 70$ to 180$ so 🤷‍♂️ btw this can easily go to 360fps in rocket league (maybe more idk haven't tried it) but I play in 240-280
Update: I made a new build with an i5 12400f but kept the Rx 5700. It can easily get 360+fps in rocket league and 160fps in destiny 2 (unfortunately, still I still have a cpu bottlenecks cuz Bungie won't optimize their game, but just know the GPU should get more than 160fps with a better CPU). I say 360+fps because on some maps (so far, only one map) , rocket league's engine cant run above 300fps, so no matter your CPU and GPU, you won't get above that.
